name: Taxonomy
description: Reads the tags of notes from their frontmatter, finds notes by tag in queries and lists the tags for agents

functions.name: hasTag
functions.description: notes with the tag or a tag nested under it in the frontmatter key tags, compared without case; a leading # is dropped

functions.name: hasTagExactly
functions.description: notes with exactly this tag in the frontmatter key tags and no other tag under it, compared without case; a leading # is dropped

functions.name: hasAnyTag
functions.description: notes with at least one tag in the frontmatter key tags
